card.name: Scattered words in body-placement phrases
card.fires_on: Mostly the "kg" after "mcg/" in per-kilogram dose rates, plus scattered words in phrases about placing or attaching things on the body, such as taped down, put over, and catheter.

modes.label: Per-kilogram dose unit
modes.description: The "kg" right after "mcg/" in a dose rate for a treatment group.

modes.label: Placing something on the body
modes.description: Words in phrases about taping, strapping or inserting something on or into the body.
modes.example: slipped the sleeve over a subject's arm, and taped it<< down>> at both ends

card.plain: It fires on the unit ending of mcg/kg doses and on some words about attaching things to the body, with no tidy link.
